S1 SUPPLEMENTARY MATERIAL Continuum limit of a qubit-regularized SU(3) lattice gauge theory on a plaquette chain Rui Xian Siew, Shailesh Chandrasekharan, and Tanmoy Bhattacharya A. DMRG details The ITensor implementation of the dmrg algorithm requires several numerical parameters in addition to the lattice Hamiltonian. One of the most important is the maximum matrix product state (mps) bond dimension, χmax, which sets the upper bound on the bond dimension while allowing it to be adjusted dynamically during the optimization. In all calculations, we used χmax = 400. Another key parameter is the truncation-error cutoff, which controls the accuracy of the calculations. We set this cutoff to 10−12 . The optimization was performed for up to 25 dmrg sweeps. These parameter values were found to perform well in our previous study of the SU(2) plaquette chain. For the lattice model, we considered periodic chains with L = 24, 32, 48, 64, 80, and 96 sites, and separately targeted low-lying states in the C = + and C = − charge-conjugation sectors. To determine the mass ratios, we computed the two lowest-energy states in the even sector and the lowest-energy state in the odd sector.
